svg.title: Elegans — connectome-constrained brain simulation
svg.desc: Left: an animated C. elegans nematode crawling up an odorant gradient on an agar plate. Right: the closed loop the project studies — connectome, spiking dynamics, behaviour, neuromodulation and plasticity — with integrated information (Φ) measured on the dynamics.
